# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 12 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 12 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_012_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 12

**12:1** She completed the purple and the scarlet and brought them to the priest. The priest blessed her and said: "Mary, the Lord God has magnified your name, and you shall be blessed among all the generations of the earth."

**12:2** Mary rejoiced and went to visit her kinswoman Elizabeth. She knocked at the door. When Elizabeth heard the knock, she set down the scarlet thread, ran to the door, and opened it. Seeing Mary, she blessed her and said: "How has this come about for me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me? For behold, the child within me leaped and blessed you."

**12:3** And Mary, in that moment, forgot the mysteries that the angel Gabriel had spoken to her. She looked up to heaven and said: "Who am I, Lord, that all generations of the earth shall call me blessed?"

**12:4** She stayed with Elizabeth for three months. Day by day her womb grew, and Mary became frightened. She went home and concealed herself from the people of Israel. She was sixteen years old when all these mysteries befell her.
